tests.name: A stage that short circuits still reports done
tests.purpose: Agent 5 can return early; the client must not be left waiting.

tests.name: Audio frame shape
tests.purpose: The client reads response_audio_base64 off a frame typed "audio".

tests.name: Builder supplies every documented response field
tests.purpose: The WS answer frame carries the full REST response shape.

tests.name: Done arrives after audio
tests.purpose: Ordering matters: audio must land before the client stops listening.

tests.name: Done frame is terminal and complete
tests.purpose: The terminal frame carries is_complete plus the settled ticket + trace.

tests.name: Each stage emits a start then a timed done
tests.purpose: Every stage is bracketed, and only the done frame carries a duration.

tests.name: Persisted trace includes the final stage
tests.purpose: All 9 stages reach the stored ticket, including ticket creation itself.

tests.name: Response is constructible from the builder
tests.purpose: Every builder value satisfies the schema's types.

tests.name: Stage frames carry the fields the client narrows on
tests.purpose: parseWsMessage keys off stage_number; StatusStream needs the rest.

tests.name: Total duration is reported
tests.purpose: The client renders this figure; it must never be absent.

tests.name: Trace steps match the frontend interface
tests.purpose: AgentTraceStep in api.ts mirrors these keys exactly.

tests.name: A malformed id is a client error
tests.purpose: Neither a UUID nor a CUST- code — reject cleanly, never 500.

tests.name: An unknown customer 404s
tests.purpose: A well-formed id for someone who does not exist.

tests.name: Analytics returns the dashboard header figures
tests.purpose: Every KPI the overview renders is present and numeric.

tests.name: Analytics survives an empty database
tests.purpose: Zero tickets must not divide by zero in the resolution rate.

tests.name: Claiming an unknown ticket 404s
tests.purpose: No silent success on a ticket that isn't there.

tests.name: Claiming assigns the ticket to the agent
tests.purpose: Claiming records who owns the ticket, so two agents don't collide.

tests.name: Detail 404s for an unknown ticket
tests.purpose: A well-formed id that does not exist is a clean 404.

tests.name: Detail includes the customer and agent trace
tests.purpose: Detail carries the trace the replay tab renders.

tests.name: Detail rejects a malformed id
tests.purpose: A non-UUID path segment is a client error, never a 500.

tests.name: Escalations lists only escalated tickets
tests.purpose: The escalation queue is the human-attention list — nothing else.

tests.name: Handoff 404s for an unknown ticket
tests.purpose: Same clean 404 as the detail route.

tests.name: Handoff summarises the ticket for a human
tests.purpose: The handoff note is what an agent reads before picking up the call.

tests.name: Profile includes the ticket history
tests.purpose: The agent needs to see prior contacts, not just this one.

tests.name: Profile resolves by internal uuid
tests.purpose: Bookmarked links use the UUID and must keep working.

tests.name: Profile resolves by short customer code
tests.purpose: Agents read the short CUST- code aloud; it has to resolve.

tests.name: Queue filters by priority
tests.purpose: Priority filtering lets an agent work the critical queue first.

tests.name: Queue filters by status
tests.purpose: A status filter excludes tickets in other states.

tests.name: Queue respects the limit
tests.purpose: An unbounded queue would be a denial-of-service on the dashboard.

tests.name: Queue returns the seeded ticket
tests.purpose: The list endpoint returns tickets with their summary fields.

tests.name: Releasing clears the assignment
tests.purpose: Releasing returns the ticket to the shared queue.

tests.name: The code lookup is case insensitive
tests.purpose: A code typed in lower case still finds the customer.

tests.name: Challenge reveals no order number or account name
tests.purpose: The RequestIdentity short-circuit must not speak account details.

tests.name: Hydrated verified session gets full data without name
tests.purpose: A later turn in a verified session gets data with no new corroboration.

tests.name: Name only lookup hides candidate order
tests.purpose: Name-only match stashes the order as candidate, never as order_data.

tests.name: Phone only lookup is challenged
tests.purpose: Phone alone: user is found but no sensitive data is populated.

tests.name: Phone with matching name is verified
tests.purpose: Phone + first name matching the account verifies the caller.

tests.name: Phone with owned order id is verified
tests.purpose: Phone + an order ID belonging to the account unlocks full data.

tests.name: Phone with wrong name is challenged
Unverified turn persists unverified
tests.purpose: A challenged turn must not mark the session as verified.

tests.name: Verified session skips challenge
tests.purpose: A session already verified (hydrated from context) is not re-challenged.

tests.name: Verified turn persists identity to session context
tests.purpose: After a corroborated turn, identity_verified=True is stored for the session.

tests.name: Distinct sessions create distinct tickets
tests.purpose: Different session_ids (e.g. after 'New conversation') get new tickets.

tests.name: Followup reuses same ticket
tests.purpose: A follow-up turn with the same session_id continues ONE ticket.

tests.name: Full pipeline graceful on llm failure
tests.purpose: Pipeline returns fallback response when Gemini is completely down.

tests.name: Full pipeline records agent trace
tests.purpose: Pipeline builds agent_trace with records for each completed stage.

tests.name: Full pipeline text input english
tests.purpose: Full 9-agent pipeline completes without error for English text input.

tests.name: Intent fallback on gemini failure
tests.purpose: Falls back to general_inquiry when Gemini fails.

tests.name: Intent set from gemini
tests.purpose: Intent, sentiment, and priority derived from Gemini response.

tests.name: Invalid session id does not crash
tests.purpose: Invalid session_id string → error set gracefully, no crash.

tests.name: Missing session id uses default
tests.purpose: PipelineState always has a valid session_id via default_factory; agent_ticket_creation must not crash.

tests.name: No input sets error
tests.purpose: Missing audio AND text → error state set.

tests.name: Phone lookup populates user data
tests.purpose: DB lookup by phone populates user_data dict.

tests.name: Policy context set from chroma
tests.purpose: Policy context string is populated from ChromaDB.

tests.name: Policy rag fallback on chroma failure
tests.purpose: Sets empty/fallback context when ChromaDB fails.

tests.name: Text input sets transcript
tests.purpose: Text-only input: transcript fields populated, no Bhashini call.

tests.name: Unknown phone returns no user data
tests.purpose: Unknown phone number: user_data stays None, no error.

tests.name: Valid session id persisted
tests.purpose: Valid UUID session_id is stored without error.

tests.name: Answer does not wait for tts or ticket
tests.purpose: run_critical returns before speech synthesis and ticket persistence.

tests.name: Conversation history in prompts is bounded
tests.purpose: A long session cannot grow the prompt without limit.

tests.name: History serialisation is empty when there is none
tests.purpose: No history means no prompt overhead at all.

tests.name: Order lookup and policy rag actually overlap
tests.purpose: Stages 3 and 4 run concurrently, not back to back.

tests.name: Order lookup issues a bounded number of queries
tests.purpose: Agent 3 stays within a small, fixed query budget.

tests.name: Policy retrieval embeds the query once
tests.purpose: One embed + one vector search per turn, not two.

tests.name: Run critical stays within the answer budget
tests.purpose: Agents 1-7 deliver an answer inside the 10s product budget.

tests.name: Total duration is reported and monotonic
tests.purpose: elapsed_ms() grows with real time and is exposed to the client.

tests.name: A dead socket does not fail the pipeline
tests.purpose: Send failures are swallowed, not reported as pipeline errors.

tests.name: Chroma failure leaves a usable fallback context
tests.purpose: A vector-store outage does not fail the turn.

tests.name: Deferred stage failure still releases the client
tests.purpose: A crash in the background stages must not hang the UI.

tests.name: Intent analysis falls back without failing the turn
tests.purpose: A Gemini outage yields a safe default intent, not an error state.

tests.name: No retrieved policy caps confidence
tests.purpose: An answer with no policy behind it cannot claim high confidence.

tests.name: Resolution outage escalates rather than guessing
tests.purpose: When the resolution LLM is down, a human gets the ticket.

tests.name: Ticket write failure is reported not hidden
tests.purpose: A failed ticket write surfaces as ticket_created=False.

tests.name: Tts failure keeps the text answer
tests.purpose: No audio is a degraded turn, not a failed one.

tests.name: Tts returning none emits no audio frame
tests.purpose: A silent TTS must not push an empty audio frame to the client.

tests.name: Default jwt secret alone blocks login
tests.purpose: A changed password but default JWT secret still blocks (forgeable tokens).

tests.name: Login allowed with defaults in development
tests.purpose: Local dev keeps working with the shipped defaults.

tests.name: Login blocked with defaults outside development
tests.purpose: 403 when default secrets are configured in a production-like env.

tests.name: Login missing fields
tests.purpose: Missing email/password returns 422 validation error.

tests.name: Login rate limited after repeated attempts
tests.purpose: The attempt after the per-IP limit returns 429 with Retry-After.

tests.name: Login success
tests.purpose: Valid credentials return a JWT access_token.

tests.name: Login wrong email
tests.purpose: Wrong email returns 401.

tests.name: Login wrong password
tests.purpose: Wrong password returns 401.

tests.name: Logout does not revoke other tokens
tests.purpose: Revocation targets one jti — a fresh login still works.

tests.name: Logout is idempotent
tests.purpose: Logging out twice with the same token succeeds both times.

tests.name: Logout revokes token
tests.purpose: A token stops working the moment it is logged out.

tests.name: Require admin invalid token
tests.purpose: require_admin raises 401 for an expired or bad token.

tests.name: Require admin missing token
tests.purpose: require_admin raises 401 when no credentials provided.

tests.name: Require admin valid token
tests.purpose: require_admin returns the subject for a valid token.

tests.name: Token expires in eight hours
tests.purpose: Access tokens carry an 8-hour expiry claim.

tests.name: Tokens carry unique jti
tests.purpose: Every issued token gets its own jti claim.

tests.name: Verify invalid token
tests.purpose: Garbage token returns None.

tests.name: Verify valid token
tests.purpose: A token created by _create_token can be decoded by _verify_token.

tests.name: Verify wrong secret
tests.purpose: Token signed with different secret returns None.

tests.name: Whoami with valid token
tests.purpose: GET /api/auth/me returns admin email when authenticated.

tests.name: Whoami without token
tests.purpose: GET /api/auth/me returns 401 without Authorization header.

tests.name: Frames are stamped with their turn
tests.purpose: Every frame identifies its turn.

tests.name: Name matching rejects a different person
tests.purpose: Corroboration by name does not accept an unrelated name.

tests.name: Phone alone does not unlock order data
tests.purpose: An uncorroborated phone lookup is challenged, not answered.

tests.name: Progress frames leak no customer data
tests.purpose: Stage frames are status only — no transcript, no order details.

tests.name: Response payload carries no internal identifiers
tests.purpose: Nothing in the customer payload exposes credentials or internals.

tests.name: Settings are not serialisable into a response
tests.purpose: Config values never travel in a pipeline payload.

tests.name: 500 does not echo internal error
tests.purpose: state.error (raw exception text) stays server-side.

tests.name: Health hides dependency error details
tests.purpose: A failing dependency reports a generic 'error', not the exception.

tests.name: History prefers customer language display text
tests.purpose: AI turns restore in the customer's language, not the English LLM copy.

tests.name: Response reports ticket created false
tests.purpose: The API response carries ticket_created so the client stays truthful.

tests.name: Ticket write failure is non fatal
tests.purpose: A failed ticket write leaves the state error-free with ticket_created=False.

tests.name: Validation error returns field messages only
Audio limit matches ten megabytes
tests.purpose: The base64 cap corresponds to ~10 MB of raw audio and fits the body cap.

tests.name: Huge body rejected with 413
tests.purpose: A body above MAX_BODY_BYTES is refused from its Content-Length.

tests.name: Normal body passes middleware
tests.purpose: Small bodies are unaffected (422 here proves it reached validation).

tests.name: Oversized text rejected
tests.purpose: Text beyond MAX_TEXT_LEN returns 422 before any pipeline work.

tests.name: Valid payload reaches pipeline
tests.purpose: A well-formed payload passes validation and runs the pipeline.

tests.name: Anonymous requests are rate limited
tests.purpose: The per-IP limit now applies with no phone supplied (was a bypass).

tests.name: Connection slots are released
tests.purpose: Closing a connection frees its slot for the same IP.

tests.name: Degrades to in process counter when store fails
tests.purpose: A broken store must not disable limiting — the fallback counts.

tests.name: Message over budget gets rate limited
tests.purpose: A message beyond the shared per-IP budget is refused pre-pipeline.

tests.name: Phone limit applies before ip limit
tests.purpose: The tighter per-phone limit still fires below the per-IP ceiling.

tests.name: Tickets list accepts real jwt
tests.purpose: A token signed with the configured secret passes require_admin.

tests.name: A 401 refetches the config and retries
tests.purpose: A rejected key is refreshed once, and the retry succeeds.

tests.name: A 500 is not treated as a stale key
tests.purpose: Only auth failures trigger a refetch; a server error must not.

tests.name: Gtts fallback runs when enabled
tests.purpose: Default behavior unchanged: fallback audio is produced.

tests.name: Gtts fallback skipped when disabled
tests.purpose: ALLOW_GTTS_FALLBACK=false: no response text is sent to Google.

tests.name: Stt error no fallback sets error state
tests.purpose: When Bhashini AND raw_text both unavailable, error state is set.

tests.name: Stt fallback when bhashini unavailable
tests.purpose: When Bhashini fails, the pipeline falls back to raw_text.

tests.name: Text passthrough no audio
tests.purpose: Text-only input passes through Voice Intake without STT call.

tests.name: Cache hit skips chroma
tests.purpose: On cache hit, Chroma is NOT called and cached values are used.

tests.name: Cache key is deterministic
tests.purpose: Same query always produces the same cache key.

tests.name: Cache miss calls chroma
tests.purpose: On cache miss, Chroma is queried and result is stored.

tests.name: Chroma error returns fallback
tests.purpose: Chroma failure sets fallback policy_context without crashing.

tests.name: Different queries produce different keys
tests.purpose: Different queries produce different cache keys.

tests.name: Get policy context returns string
tests.purpose: get_policy_context returns a non-empty string.

tests.name: Policy rag agent handles chroma failure
tests.purpose: Agent 4 sets fallback context if ChromaDB is unavailable.

tests.name: Policy rag agent uses chroma
tests.purpose: Agent 4 (Policy RAG) calls chroma service correctly.

tests.name: Query policies returns list
tests.purpose: query_policies returns a list of dicts.

tests.name: Llm outage fallback escalates
tests.purpose: The Gemini fallback resolution (confidence 0.3) must trip Rule 5.

tests.name: Multiple rules all recorded
tests.purpose: Every triggered rule appears in the joined reason.

tests.name: Analyze intent angry sentiment
tests.purpose: Angry sentiment is correctly extracted from LLM response.

tests.name: Analyze intent fallback on llm failure
tests.purpose: On LLM failure, analyze_intent returns safe fallback dict.

tests.name: Analyze intent happy path
tests.purpose: analyze_intent returns structured dict on success.

tests.name: Generate resolution fallback on error
tests.purpose: Returns fallback resolution dict when LLM fails.

tests.name: Generate resolution inform
tests.purpose: Generates Inform resolution for non-critical case.

tests.name: Generate response fallback on error
tests.purpose: Returns apologetic fallback response when LLM fails.

tests.name: Generate response happy path
tests.purpose: Generates customer response with correct structure.

tests.name: Clear conversation
tests.purpose: clear_conversation removes all turns for session.

tests.name: Get cache miss returns none
tests.purpose: get_cache returns None for missing keys.

tests.name: Get conversation history empty
tests.purpose: Returns empty list for unknown session.

tests.name: Increment with expiry counts correctly
tests.purpose: increment_with_expiry returns incremented counter value.

tests.name: Rate limit allows within limit
tests.purpose: Returns True for requests within rate limit.

tests.name: Rate limit blocks over limit
tests.purpose: Returns False when rate limit exceeded.

tests.name: Set and get cache
tests.purpose: set_cache and get_cache work correctly.

tests.name: Store and retrieve conversation
tests.purpose: store_conversation_turn then get_conversation_history returns turns.

tests.name: Pipeline state default session id is uuid
Support ticket has expected status field
User has required audit fields
tests.purpose: User model includes audit fields (created_by, updated_by, updated_at).

tests.name: A closed client is replaced
tests.purpose: A client closed at shutdown must not be handed out again.

tests.name: A failed lookup is not cached
tests.purpose: Caching a failure would turn a blip into a 6-hour outage.

tests.name: Closing is idempotent
tests.purpose: Shutdown runs the lifespan teardown; a double close must not raise.

tests.name: Concurrent cold lookups fetch once
tests.purpose: A cold start with several simultaneous turns must not stampede.

tests.name: Connect fails faster than a slow read
tests.purpose: An unreachable host must fail fast; a slow one gets time to answer.

tests.name: Each language is cached separately
tests.purpose: Hindi's config must never be served for a Tamil request.

tests.name: Every retrieved policy appears
tests.purpose: Truncating the context would silently drop grounding.

tests.name: Force refresh bypasses the cache
tests.purpose: The escape hatch for a rotated inference key.

tests.name: Get policy context delegates to the same path
tests.purpose: Kept as a thin wrapper so existing callers keep working.

tests.name: No matches produces an explicit statement
tests.purpose: The LLM must be told there is no policy, not handed an empty string.

tests.name: Query with context searches once for both shapes
tests.purpose: The whole point: one embed + one search, two return values.

tests.name: Retrieved policies render with title and relevance
tests.purpose: The resolution prompt needs the source and the score, not raw text.

tests.name: Stt and tts configs do not collide
tests.purpose: Same language, different task — different pipeline.

tests.name: The same client is reused across calls
tests.purpose: One pooled client, so we pay TLS setup once rather than per call.

tests.name: The second lookup makes no network call
tests.purpose: A cache hit is what removes a full round trip from every turn.

Ticket search matches summary case insensitively
